name: fairbuild-schedule-of-values
description: Fairbuild Schedule of Values: the schedule of values line by line against what has been billed and what the field says is in place: lines billed ahead of progress (over billing), lines billed behind it (money not yet asked for), a schedule of values that does not add up to the contract, approved change orders missing from it, and billing on zero-value lines. Drafts the project manager memo. Never changes a billing.
